rationale: Price gapped up 4.75% at the open and has already reversed sharply, dropping from the session high of $25.86 to $24.76, now sitting at only 28.4% of today's range and below both the 9-EMA ($25.37) and session VWAP ($24.92), indicating strong intraday selling pressure.
